I’m not able to create calendar events or set reminders directly, but I can give you a ready‑to‑copy note that you can paste into your phone’s Notes app, Google Keep, Apple Reminders, or any other reminder tool you use. --- ### 📅 Reminder – 27 March 2024 **Title:** Netflix Subscription Renewal **Details:** - Check current plan and price. - Decide whether to keep the current plan or switch to a different tier. - Make payment before the renewal date to avoid interruption. - Verify that the new billing cycle starts on the correct date. **Action Items:** 1. Open Netflix app or website. 2. Go to “Account” → “Subscription” → “Change plan” (if needed). 3. Confirm payment method and billing date. 4. Set a calendar event for the renewal date if you want an additional alert. --- #### How to set it up: | Platform | Steps | |----------|-------| | **iOS (Reminders)** | 1. Open Reminders.
2. Tap “New Reminder”.
3. Enter title “Netflix Subscription Renewal”.
4. Tap the “i” icon → “Add Date” → set 27 Mar 2024.
5. Toggle “Remind me on a day” and set a time (e.g., 9 AM). | | **Android (Google Calendar)** | 1. Open Calendar.
2. Tap “+” → “Event”.
3. Title: “Netflix Subscription Renewal”.
4. Date: 27 Mar 2024.
5. Time: choose a convenient time.
6. Add a notification (e.g., 1 day before). | | **Windows (Outlook)** | 1. Open Outlook Calendar.
2. New Appointment → Title “Netflix Subscription Renewal”.
3. Date: 27 Mar 2024.
4. Set reminder (e.g., 15 min before). | Feel free to adjust the time or add any extra notes that suit your workflow. If you’d like, I can also help you draft a quick email or text to send yourself as a backup reminder. Just let me know!
